name: railway_list_projects
description: List the Railway projects the token can access: projects { edges { node { id name } } }. The project `id` is what railway_get_project and railway_create_custom_domain need. Use this first to resolve a project name to its id. Takes no parameters. (If this returns empty for a workspace token, the project may live under `me { projects }` — see the railway-domains skill.)

body_defaults.query: query { projects { edges { node { id name } } } }
